name: ai-quiz-builder-workspace
description: QuizVerse AI — Fullstack Monorepo Root Dev Runner

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
